Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

zupmxio 0.1.0

First release. zupmxio holds a population PK/PD model as one R object, reads it from NONMEM, rxode2/nlmixr2 and mrgsolve, writes it to any of the three, and checks that two models are the same model.

  • pmx_read_nonmem(), pmx_read_rxode2() and pmx_read_mrgsolve() read a model: closed forms (ADVAN 1 to 4, 11 and 12) and ODE systems, with random effects, covariates, dosing attributes and residual models. Code outside the supported subset is refused with its position, never guessed.

  • pmx_write_nonmem(), pmx_write_rxode2() and pmx_write_mrgsolve() write it, each reporting its fidelity (exact, equivalent or lossy) and what was lost. A construct that would change predictions is refused, never dropped.

  • pmx_compare() simulates both models on a pmx_design() (single dose, infusion, multiple doses and steady state, for a typical subject and subjects with random effects), each on its own engine and never on the engine of the writer under test, and compares the predictions point by point. A failed comparison is a value that says where the models differ. pmx_report() writes a comparison as Markdown.

  • pmx_read_tables() reads NONMEM $TABLE output, and pmx_compare(tables, model) checks a translation against the run’s own PRED.

  • pmx_write_json() and pmx_read_json() save and reload a model unchanged.

  • zupmxio_corpus() lists the shipped models, each in every format that holds it, with the predictions they agree on.

Developed by Pedro Baltazar.
